title: Grace Days on Late Charges under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Where two or more service credits stand allowed on the contract in the twelve months up to the day the charge is raised and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the grace days allowed are the disputed account grace days; where fewer than two service credits stand allowed over those twelve months and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the grace days allowed are the wind-down grace days; and where no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the grace days allowed are the late charge grace days printed against the service model.

### The figures these conditions carry

On every Workplace Cafe Management Program contract the disputed account grace days stand at 21 calendar days and the wind-down grace days stand at 14 calendar days.

### The conditions as a table of record facts

| Service credits allowed in the twelve months up to the day the charge is raised | A day of written notice of termination standing on the contract | Grace days allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | Yes | The disputed account grace days, 21 calendar days |
| Fewer than 2 | Yes | The wind-down grace days, 14 calendar days |
| Any count | No | The late charge grace days printed against the service model |

### Judgements on hypothetical records

On a hypothetical contract carrying a day of written notice of termination and showing 2 service credits allowed in the twelve months up to the day the charge is raised, the count reaches two, so the grace days allowed are the disputed account grace days, 21 calendar days.

On a hypothetical contract carrying a day of written notice of termination and showing 1 service credit allowed over those twelve months, the count falls below two, so the grace days allowed are the wind-down grace days, 14 calendar days.

Where no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the count of service credits allowed over those twelve months does not enter the judgement at all, and the grace days allowed are the late charge grace days printed against the service model.
